bias.en: Downtrend · oversold, held $54.6 on the close
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 超卖，收盘守住 $54.6

read.en: Intel slipped 0.5% on Nov 17 to $55.17, trading $52.42–55.24. It is below the 5-day ($58.8), 10-day ($57.8), 30-day ($79.9), 100-day ($96.7) and 200-day ($87.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5, below zero, histogram almost closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($71.32), and RSI is 29.7, oversold.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月17日下跌 0.5%，收于 $55.17，盘中区间 $52.42–55.24。股价位于 5 日（$58.8）、10 日（$57.8）、30 日（$79.9）、100 日（$96.7）和 200 日均线（$87.5）下方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图几乎收拢（接近上穿）；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$71.32），RSI 为 29.7，处于超卖区。

read.en: No level changed on the close: the $52.42 low dipped under the $54.6–54.9 support before the close recovered above it. Resistance is $55.5–57.3 (Nov 4–16 lows and highs), then $57.8–59.4 (10 and 5-day) and $61.2–62.8. Support is $54.6–54.9 (Nov 6 and 16 lows), then $52.25–52.4 (Nov 5 close, Nov 17 low) and $51.5 (Nov 5 low). A close above $57.3 would target $57.8–59.4; below $54.6, $51.5–52.4.

r.en: Nov 4 low $56.77, Nov 10 low $56.85 and Nov 13 low $57.00; Nov 16 high $57.20
